newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Metway due diligence near completion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Metway due diligence near completion.

text.p: Metway Bank Ltd said on Thursday that due diligence on the proposed merger of the bank and government-owned Suncorp and the Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC) was close to completion and independent valuations were "well advanced."
"Due diligence on the three groups is nearly finalised and the independent valuer is well advanced," Metway chairman Frank Haly said in a leter to shareholders.

Independent experts, including due diligence consultants Price Waterhouse and independent valuer Baring Brothers Burrows & Co Ltd, were now preparing their reports on the terms of the proposed scheme of arrangement, Haly said.
"At this stage we expect to mail an information memorandum in October and hold shareholder meetings in November," he said.
Haly told shareholders in the annual report that planning for post-merger operations coincided with the Wallis Committee review of Australia's financial system.

"The bancassurance approach represented by the Metway/Suncorp/QIDC proposal will no doubt be aired before the review and the merged group may well be positioned in the vanguard of change to emerge from its findings," Haly said.
"If anything the Wallis Commitee is likely to reinforce the competitive pressures which are currently reshaping banking in Australia," Haly said.
